answer: Proof-of-stake slashing deters Sybil identity floods: each agent must lock collateral that is forfeited the moment it signs two conflicting ledgers. Minting a thousand fake nodes therefore means posting a thousand bonds, so an attacker's cost rises in direct tide with the number of identities claimed. Honest operators earn fees only on the horizon of verified work, while a cheater's stake is burned, leaving even a remote tundra farm of phantom agents economically pointless.
